test_cases.title: Login with valid credentials
test_cases.goal: Open the application and log in with the email and password from the test data.

test_cases.title: Search and open a product
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Search for {search_term}, open {product_b} from the results and view its details.

test_cases.title: Add two products and change quantity in the cart
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Add {product_a} and {product_b} to the cart, open the cart and increase the quantity of {product_a} to {quantity}.
expected: In the cart, the quantity shown next to {product_a} is {quantity}

test_cases.title: Place an order from product details
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Search for {product_a}, open its details, set the quantity to {quantity}, add it to the cart, go to checkout and place the order.

test_cases.title: New order appears in My Orders
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Place an order for {product_b}, note the Order ID shown on the confirmation screen, then open My Orders.
expected: The order ID that was shown on the confirmation screen is listed in My Orders
That order shows the status Processing

test_cases.title: Login rejected with a wrong password
test_cases.goal: Open the application, go to Login and try to sign in with the email from the test data and the wrong_password from the test data.

test_cases.title: Registration rejected when passwords do not match
test_cases.goal: Open the application, go to Register and fill First Name {reg_first_name}, Last Name {reg_last_name}, Email Address {reg_email}, Phone Number {reg_phone}, Password {reg_password}, Confirm Password {reg_password_mismatch}, accept the terms and tap Create Account.

test_cases.title: Registration rejected without accepting the terms
test_cases.goal: Open the application, go to Register, fill every field with the reg_ values from the test data (both passwords {reg_password}), do NOT accept the terms, and tap Create Account.

test_cases.title: Cart total equals the sum of the items
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Add {product_a} to the cart and open the cart.
expected: The Total equals the sum of price x quantity of every item shown in the cart

test_cases.title: Control: a product that does not exist cannot be opened
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Search for {missing_product} and open its product details.

test_cases.title: Control: product details do not show a feature the app does not have
test_cases.precondition: Log in with the email and password from the test data (skip if already logged in).
test_cases.goal: Search for {search_term} and open {product_b} from the results.
